body:
client
dev tun
proto udp
remote vpn.example.test 1194
resolv-retry infinite
nobind
persist-key
persist-tun
block-ipv6
route-ipv6 ::/1
route-ipv6 8000::/1
remote-cert-tls server
sndbuf 0
rcvbuf 0
fast-io
cipher AES-256-GCM
auth SHA256
verb 3
dhcp-option DNS 10.99.0.1
# Локальные сети — мимо туннеля, на физический интерфейс.
route 10.0.0.0 255.0.0.0 net_gateway
route 100.64.0.0 255.192.0.0 net_gateway
route 172.16.0.0 255.240.0.0 net_gateway
route 192.168.0.0 255.255.0.0 net_gateway
route 10.99.0.0 255.255.255.0 vpn_gateway

<ca>
<pem>
</ca>
<cert>
<pem>
</cert>
<key>
<secret>
</key>
<tls-crypt>
<secret>
</tls-crypt>
